Definition
[Focal-point-free geodesic] 1. ch10:4.7A geodesic $\gamma :[0,a]\to M$ is focal-point free on $(0,a]$ if some ball $B_\varepsilon (0)\subset \gamma '(0)^\perp $ has the property that $\gamma $ has no focal point relative to $\Sigma _\varepsilon =\exp _{\gamma (0)}B_\varepsilon (0)$. Since $\Sigma _\varepsilon $ is geodesic at $\gamma (0)$, a Jacobi field with $J(0)\ne 0$ and $J'(0)=0$ has $S_{\gamma '(0)}J(0)=0$.
